name: idc-stageii-colorectal-ct
description: This dataset includes abdominal or pelvic enhanced CT images within 10 days before surgery of 230 patients with stage II colorectal cancer (CRC). Images were acquired on Sensation 64 (Siemens Healthcare, Erlangen, Germany) CT scanner or Brilliance (Philips Healthcare, Best, The Netherlands) CT scanner. Please see the StageII-Colorectal-CT wiki to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
